description: This file defines an Android activity 'PhotosListActivity' that displays a list of photos fetched from a remote XML feed (Picasa). It sets up the activity layout and initializes a cursor adapter to parse and display the XML data.

classes.name: PhotosListActivity
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays photos retrieved from a remote XML feed, utilizing a custom cursor adapter for parsing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method where the activity sets its content view and initializes the list adapter with data from a Picasa XML feed.
